name: b31-scabbard
negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, text, watermark, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, fused fingers
prompt: The wind drifts fine sand into the open mouth of the abandoned scabbard and over its loose strap, the red-violet afterglow slowly fades toward night over the dunes. The scabbard stays in place. Bitterness, regret, despair, a loss that cannot be undone. Static camera, a very slow push-in. Keep every object exactly as in the image, nothing added or removed. No people, no feet, no hands, no faces, no blood, no moon, no text.
